Name: FS Wearable Mermaid Pendant Accessory
Author: Thimblewitch
Description:
[size=3]I was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/104804993]beyondrecovery[/url]'s FS Mermaid Pendant for Farmer. I really liked their mod but the shell pendant and the light colours of the cord didn't really do it for me aesthetically. This is by no means a dig at beyondrecovery at all and I deeply apologise if it sounds like one. I did not edit their assets at all and was simply inspired to try my hand at drawing my own, I am by no means a pro when it comes to moding and or pixel art so I apologise if it looks funky.

Since I'm only a beginner I'm going to stick to creating Fashion Sense Packs only though so don't expect too much from me lol.

My pack adds three versions of a wearable mermaid pendant for your farmer
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Version 1 has a gold cord and a blue shell pendant[/size]
[*][size=3]Version 2 has a silver cord and a blue shell pendant[/size]
[*][size=3]Version 3 has a teal cord and a blue shell pendant, this version is meant to resemble the vanilla mermaid pendant for those that might want that.[/size]
[/list][size=3]

[b][u]INSTALLATION[/u][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the file and place it in your Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]In game, the pendants will be found in the Accessories section of the Fashion Sense Hand Mirror[/size]
[/list][size=3]

[u][b]ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS[/b][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]PeacefulEnd, the creator of Fashion Sense because without their mod this pack would not have been made possible.[/size]
[/list]
